components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Paper fill, inverts on hover; the only primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:46px; padding:0 22px; background:#f4f4f2; color:#0b0b0f; border:1px solid #f4f4f2; font-family:'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-stretch:75%; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; letter-spacing:0.03em; text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#0b0b0f; color:#f4f4f2; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f4f4f2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Mode Button
components.description: Quiet 1px control in the command line.
components.css: .ds-mode { background:none; border:1px solid #2b3037; color:#9aa0a6; padding:7px 10px; font:500 12px/1 'Martian Mono',ui-monospace,monospace; font-stretch:75%; letter-spacing:0.1em; cursor:pointer; transition:color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .ds-mode:hover { color:#f4f4f2; border-color:#f4f4f2; } .ds-mode:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f4f4f2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Source Chip
components.description: A person in the sources list; current one is red with a 4px rule.

components.name: Readout
components.description: Label and a huge green or red number.
components.css: .ds-num span { display:block; font:400 28px/1 'Bebas Neue',Oswald,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#f4f4f2; } .ds-num b { display:block; font:400 140px/0.82 'Bebas Neue',Oswald,'Arial Narrow',sans-serif; color:#3ddc6c; }

components.name: Command Line
components.description: Green prompt, borderless input with a block caret.
components.html: >
components.css: .ds-cmd { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:16px 22px; border-top:1px solid #2b3037; background:#0b0b0f; } .ds-prompt { color:#3ddc6c; font:400 24px/1 'Martian Mono',monospace; } .ds-cmd input { flex:1; background:none; border:0; outline:none; color:#f4f4f2; caret-color:#f4f4f2; caret-shape:block; font:400 24px/1.2 'Martian Mono',monospace; font-stretch:75%; } .ds-cmd input::placeholder { color:#858a92; } .ds-cmd:focus-within { outline:2px solid #f4f4f2; outline-offset:-2px; }

narrative.overview:
A broadcast has been interrupted to ask one question. The system is a test card: near-black ink, paper white, one signal red for what breaks, one green for what holds, and SMPTE color bars as the single decorative signature. Display type is condensed Bebas Neue caps; everything else is Martian Mono at condensed width.

Text is minimal by rule: one headline, one primary button, big numbers, names only where a number needs one. Frames are flat 1px lines, with no radii and no shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Color bars are the only decorative color; red and green are the only semantic colors.
Big Bebas numbers carry state; mono carries names, timecode and tools.
Flat, square, 1px line frames. No radius, no shadow.
Motion is signal degradation and is a still frame under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red means broken or removed; green means held or written. Nothing else is saturated outside the bars.

rules.name: The Bars Stay Decorative Rule
rules.body: The seven bar colors never encode state and never appear on controls.

rules.name: The Number Is The Headline Rule
rules.body: If a thing can be said as a big number, do not say it as a sentence.

rules.name: The Flat Frame Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by a 1px line or by a tone step, never by a shadow or radius.

dos: Do let a big Bebas number carry each state and color it red or green.
Do keep one headline and one primary button per screen; names only beside a number.
Do keep every frame 1px line, radius 0, no shadows.
Do keep mid (#858a92) as the lightest text on ink that is decorative or secondary; it was contrast-checked.
Do show a settled state under reduced motion and restack phone layouts without page-level horizontal scroll.
Do keep focus visible: 2px paper outline, 3px offset.
donts: Don't use a color bar color for state, controls or text.
Don't add a third saturated accent, gradients, glow or decorative dots.
Don't add paragraphs, captions or log blocks to the hero or the workbench default view.
Don't encode risk by color alone; keep the number, the dashed spoke or the label.
